record.question: The strength of Iron and folic acid for pregnant women as per Anaemia Mukt Bharat is:
options: 60 mg elemental iron and 0.5mg folic acid
100 mg elemental iron and 0.5 mg folic acid
60 mg elemental iron and 0.1 mg of folic acid
100 mg of elemental iron and 0.1 mg of folic acid
record.explanation: Answer A: 60 mg elemental iron and 0.5mg folic acid. Anaemia Mukt Bharat recommends daily iron–folic acid supplementation for pregnant women containing 60 mg elemental iron and 500 μg (0.5 mg) folic acid. Reference: https://nhm.gov.in/index1.php?lang=1&level=2&sublinkid=822&lid=219. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
